PUBLIC FILE (GH Pages): no staff names, phone extensions, form links, or anything not fit for a public page. audience: all | student | teacher (teacher items render only for a verified teacher, but are still publicly readable here). date = the day it happens (null = standing reminder); showFrom = first day to show (default: 21 days before date); until = last day to show (default: date).
